AIDDbot

AIDDbot is a harness of skills, commands and subagents that works with any agent.

Build software you can trust|

Why do you need AIDD?

The agents are effective in isolated tasks; AI-Driven Development helps you build real-world projects.

//Detail or invent

Lack of context produces plausible invention.

Spec-Driven Development imposes detailed intent.

//Guide or chaos

Code that ignores your standards.

Rules over tools tailored to the project.

//Verify or hope

Silent drift until fixes are expensive.

Human in the loop at critical checkpoints.
Get started

Three doors

Convenient commands cover the entire lifecycle chaining skills into new sub-agents, optimizing the context window.

//explore-and-extract

Document what is there — architecture, schemas, coding rules. Works on greenfield and legacy repos alike.

//spec-feature

Turn a requirement into a spec and wait for your approval. Then plan, build, verify, qualify and release the solution.

//explore-and-refactor

Re-explore for technical drift, pick defects, and drive each fix through a refactor spec.

See the workflow

Plain markdown. Any agent.

No CLI, no package install, just copy the `.agents` folder and run. AIDDbot works with the editors you already use.

//Antigravity · Cursor · Devin · Kiro · VSCode · JetBrains · Zed

IDEs that load project context from your repo.

//ClaudeCode · Codex · Copilot · Composer · OpenCode

Agent harnesses that read or invoke skills.
